scope: 从已取得导出中选取可见用户/助手消息；不含内部推理、工具日志或授权码。不声称完整平台记录；保留来源顺序，文件之间可能重叠。子代理初始指令未必由导出接口返回；不能据助手回复条数推定实现调用次数。

messages.text: I’ll read the diff, calculate the required finding count, and check the changed behavior for gaps.

The main behavior changes are small; most of the diff adds verification evidence. I’m checking whether the new tests and report metadata fully support the completion claims, especially strict DTO types and fail-closed browser reporting.

Two gaps are reproducible: the room-contract test still passes with `ok: 1` and a floating-point total, and the browser wrapper can turn a returned `FAIL` with no viewport checks into `PASS` if any `.png` file exists. I’m separating these from smaller coverage and reproducibility improvements.

- Finding floor: 214,454 bytes / 1,000 = 214.454 kB; N = min(floor(√214.454 + 1), 10) = min(15, 10) = **10**.
- [Room DTO assertions](/Users/mima0000/Documents/Codex/2026-11-12/bmad-b/outputs/group-room-booking/tests/test_room_schedule.py:93) still omit strict types and values for the rooms envelope. I injected `ok: 1` and `total: 3.0`; this test passed. Add strict assertions for `ok`, `items`, and `total`, including empty responses, where `False == 0` currently masks another invalid total.
- [Block-reason assertions](/Users/mima0000/Documents/Codex/2026-11-12/bmad-b/outputs/group-room-booking/scripts/verify_auth_browser.cjs:119) use the same reason for both blocks. Rendering the first block’s reason on every block would pass. Give the blocks distinct reasons and assert each record’s corresponding DOM text.
- [Browser PASS publication](/Users/mima0000/Documents/Codex/2026-11-12/bmad-b/outputs/group-room-booking/scripts/verify_auth_browser.py:236) unconditionally overwrites the child report’s result. A returned `{"result":"FAIL","results":[]}` plus one image file produces exit code zero and `PASS`. Validate the child verdict and required viewport/scenario results before publishing success.
- [Screenshot validation](/Users/mima0000/Documents/Codex/2026-11-12/bmad-b/outputs/group-room-booking/scripts/verify_auth_browser.py:231) checks only that some filename ends in `.png`. One arbitrary file containing non-image bytes satisfies this condition. Validate the expected screenshot manifest for the selected scenario and reject missing or unreadable images.
- [Playwright metadata](/Users/mima0000/Documents/Codex/2026-11-12/bmad-b/outputs/group-room-booking/scripts/verify_auth_browser.py:202) reads the requested package directory, while the driver loads Playwright through Node’s module resolution. A nearer `node_modules` can shadow `NODE_PATH`, making the recorded package differ from the executed package. Return the resolved package path/version from the driver and verify agreement.
- [Environment metadata](/Users/mima0000/Documents/Codex/2026-11-12/bmad-b/outputs/group-room-booking/scripts/verify_auth_browser.py:199) omits the Node runtime version and browser executable selection. Record these alongside normalized scenario arguments so the browser evidence can be reproduced with the same runner configuration.
- [Source-change regression coverage](/Users/mima0000/Documents/Codex/2026-11-12/bmad-b/outputs/group-room-booking/tests/test_browser_verification.py:66) mocks `source_fingerprints` entirely. It therefore passes even if the real helper stops hashing application files or fixtures. Add a temporary-tree test exercising the actual helper and detecting edits, additions, and removals.
- [Opposite-parent HTTP evidence](/Users/mima0000/Documents/Codex/2026-11-12/bmad-b/outputs/group-room-booking/docs/evidence/epic-1-followup/auth-http-opposite-parent.json:1) contains neither the parent configuration nor the effective child overrides. Its contents are indistinguishable from an ordinary run. Preserve the exact invocation and safe configuration values, and add a regression assertion for the child environment.
- [Authentication timeout tests](/Users/mima0000/Documents/Codex/2026-11-12/bmad-b/outputs/group-room-booking/tests/test_auth_js.cjs:13) give credentials no values and submit `{}`. They verify unlocking but cannot detect credentials being cleared or changed after either timeout stage. Populate both fields, exercise the submit handler, and assert submitted and retained values.
- [Schedule focus restoration](/Users/mima0000/Documents/Codex/2026-11-12/bmad-b/outputs/group-room-booking/booking_app/static/schedule.js:94) always focuses the query button when an asynchronous request succeeds. If the user moves to another enabled form while waiting, completion interrupts their typing. Preserve focus when the user has deliberately moved elsewhere, and test that delayed-response case.
